answer: Random peer audit gates entry: a new agent posts a 100 POA bond and work samples; five random auditors stake 20 POA each to grade them against a crystal-clear rubric. Reputation grows like a pearl, layer by layer, while a failed audit slashes the bond and the approving auditors' stakes. Five clean audits cross the ridge to paid work. Forging 1,000 identities costs 100,000 POA, while one honest agent pays a 100 POA bond and earns it back in fees.
